description: This file contains the implementation of the AzureTableGrainStorage class, which provides storage functionalities for Orleans grains using Azure Table Storage. It includes methods for reading, writing, and clearing grain state data, as well as serialization/deserialization mechanisms and internal classes for data management and logging.

classes.name: AzureTableGrainStorage
classes.description: Implements grain storage using Azure Table Storage, handling serialization, data chunking, optimistic concurrency, and lifecycle participation.

classes.name: AzureTableGrainStorage.GrainStateTableDataManager
classes.description: Handles data operations (read, write, delete) for Azure Table Storage related to grain state.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads grain state data from Azure Table Storage and populates the grain state object.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Serializes grain state data and writes it to Azure Table Storage with optimistic concurrency control.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Clears or deletes grain state data in Azure Table Storage based on configuration.

methods.name: ConvertToStorageFormat
methods.description: Serializes grain state into Azure storage format, supporting binary and string formats with chunking.

methods.name: ConvertFromStorageFormat
methods.description: Deserializes stored Azure Table entity data back into grain state object.

methods.name: GetKeyString
methods.description: Generates a sanitized partition key string based on grain ID and service ID.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the storage provider, preparing the Azure table client.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Cleans up resources when shutting down.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of a grain state object.
